name: IN22-Conv — All Pairs
description: N-way parallel evaluation benchmark from AI4Bharat IndicTrans2. 22 scheduled Indian languages + English, 1503 sentences across 44 conversations, covering daily dialogue, hobbies, college/school life, social scenarios. Conversational domain.

segments.name: Test
segments.purpose: MT evaluation — conversational-domain benchmark across 22 Indian languages + English

download.instructions: GATED on HuggingFace (gated: auto). Accept the CC-BY-4.0 terms on the dataset page once, then set HF_TOKEN. The harness fetches IN22_benchmark.tar.gz and reads the line-aligned files at IN22_benchmark/conv/test.{flores_code} (eng_Latn, tel_Telu, tam_Taml, …). The N-way set is line-index aligned — no pivot needed.

source.citation: Gala et al. (2023). IndicTrans2: Towards High-Quality and Accessible Machine Translation Models for all 22 Scheduled Indian Languages.

license.aiTraining: Permitted with attribution under CC-BY-4.0 terms.

contamination.reasoning: Specialized Indian language benchmark released alongside IndicTrans2 (2023). Not widely crawled compared to FLORES+ or WMT datasets. Primarily used within the Indic NLP research community. However, it is publicly available on HuggingFace, so contamination in future models is possible.

_provenance.populatedFrom: AI4Bharat IN22-Conv HuggingFace dataset card, IndicTrans2 paper (arXiv:2305.16307)

doi.basis: IN22 Dogri is the Dogri-proper written standard (dgo); the macrolanguage's only other member, Kangri (xnr), is a distinct language never labeled plain 'Dogri'.

kok.basis: AI4Bharat IndicTrans2/IN22 documents Konkani as gom_Deva — Goan Konkani (IndicTrans2 language list).

ori.basis: AI4Bharat IndicTrans2/IN22 documents Odia as ory_Orya (IndicTrans2 language list).

san.basis: Modern composed Sanskrit test text is Classical Sanskrit (cls); the macrolanguage's only other member, Vedic Sanskrit (vsn), is a closed historical corpus.
